annotation.title_clean: A European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems, a milestone towards cooperative, connected and automated mobility (COM(2016) 766 final)
annotation.title_en: A European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems, a milestone towards cooperative, connected and automated mobility
named_instruments_referenced: G7 Declaration on automated and connected driving
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Communication setting out an EU strategy for coordinated deployment of Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (C-ITS) by 2019 as a step toward connected and automated vehicles. It prioritises Day 1 services and addresses cybersecurity, data protection, hybrid communication, interoperability, compliance assessment, a legal framework under the ITS Directive, and international cooperation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines Day 1 and Day 1.5 C-ITS service lists for coordinated EU deployment from 2019
Commission to develop a common EU C-ITS security and certificate policy based on PKI (guidance 2017)
Data protection by design, DPIA template and GDPR compliance for C-ITS data; guidance in 2018
Hybrid communication (ETSI ITS-G5 plus cellular), C-Roads platform for interoperability testing and a common compliance assessment process
Commission may adopt delegated acts under ITS Directive 2010/40/EU by 2018; funding via CEF and Horizon 2020
